- Transform the adventure game into a cooler, non-cute 3D sci-fi game while preserving its gameplay.

- Rebranded the game as **VOID//RUN — Shard Protocol**, with a dark sci-fi look, neon hazards, angular environments, armored characters, and shards.
- Replaced the 2D world renderer with a Three.js scene while keeping the existing interface and touch controls.

- `index.html`: Game UI, current branding/text, and favicon.
- `game.js`: Three.js scene, movement, interactions, progression, and controls.
- `style.css`: Sci-fi interface styling and responsive mobile controls.
- `screenshots/void-run.jpg`: Latest browser screenshot.
